name: components_signal_lookup_maps
source:
// TABLE-driven lookup blocks: 1-D map (slope-2 line -> 6 at 3) and a 2-D
// curve family (midway between U=x and U=3x at x=5 -> 10).
// EXPECT m1.out.sig = 6
// EXPECT m2.out.sig = 10
TABLE lin(x)
  0   0
  10  20
END
TABLE fam(x : y = 0, 10)
  0    0    0
  10   10   30
END
SigConstant X(k=3)
SigConstant X2(k=5)
SigMap   M1(map$=lin)
SigMap2  M2(map$=fam)
connect(X.out, M1.in)
connect(X2.out, M2.in1, M2.in2)
